mobends.config.item_attack.tooltip: Separate entries with semicolons or new lines. Use namespace:item=TOOL, FISTS, or SWORD. Leading and trailing * wildcards are supported; leave empty for automatic detection.
mobends.config.item_use.tooltip: Separate entries with semicolons or new lines. Use namespace:item=FOOD, BOW, or SHIELD. Leading and trailing * wildcards are supported; leave empty for automatic detection.
mobends.config.vanilla_armor.tooltip: Armor item IDs matching these semicolon-separated patterns keep Minecraft's vanilla armor rendering. Leading and trailing * wildcards are supported.
mobends.config.vanilla_entities.tooltip: Non-player entity IDs matching these semicolon-separated patterns bypass Mo' Bends and keep vanilla rendering. Players use the separate player toggle.
mobends.gui.packs_disabled: BendsPacks are disabled by this server.
